create_UserProductTourSerializer: create a DRF serializer for UserProductTour that loads tour steps and dependencies from YAML configs
validate_UserProductTour_name: validate a product tour name against available YAML config files in the configs directory
get_UserProductTour_steps: get tour steps from a YAML config file for a given product tour name

validate_UserProductTour_interaction_dat: validate product tour interaction data against a pydantic model schema
